profile.summary: Business Analyst Fresher with a Software Engineering background; experienced in requirement analysis, SRS, and User Stories. Strong in analytical thinking and process improvement.

responsibilities_and_impact: Facilitated technical training by translating complex logic into clear, structured requirements for students.
Conducted gap analysis on student performance to tailor learning paths and improve outcomes.
Managed stakeholders (parents & students) to ensure alignment on progress and educational objectives.
Data Analysis: Analyzed sales trends and customer behavior to drive data-informed business decisions.
Workflow Optimization: Resolved operational bottlenecks and streamlined service processes.
Business Operations: Managed end-to-end daily operations, supply chain; and quality control.
Requirement Analysis: Defined optimized financial solutions by analyzing precise client requirements.
CRM Administration: Maintained data integrity to enhance workflow efficiency.
Process Optimization: Delivered actionable insights to resolve recurring service bottlenecks.
Requirement Documentation: Assisted in drafting and maintaining BRD, SRS, and User Guides to ensure clear system specifications.
Quality Assurance & UAT: Supported User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by developing test scenarios and validating system outputs against requirements.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Facilitated communication between technical teams and Japanese stakeholders to clarify requirements and ensure project alignment.

project_evidence: Process Optimization: Cut simulated loan approval lead time by 90%+ via workflow re-design. Documentation: Authored SRS, User Stories; and AC for a rule-based credit scoring system. Architecture & UI/UX: Designed UML diagrams and created interactive prototypes via AI-driven development. Logic Validation: Utilized AI-assisted analysis to simulate edge cases and refine requirement consistency.
